name: convertrilo
description: Create and manage Convertrilo video encoding jobs from MCP clients and agent workflows.

environmentVariables.name: CONVERTRILO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Convertrilo API key used to authenticate requests.

environmentVariables.name: CONVERTRILO_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional API base URL. Defaults to https://api.convertrilo.com.

tools.name: create_encode_job
tools.description: Create a Convertrilo on-demand video encoding job from a source URL.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Read the current status for a Convertrilo on-demand job.

tools.name: wait_for_job
tools.description: Poll a Convertrilo on-demand job until success, failed, or canceled.

tools.name: get_token_balance
tools.description: Read the authenticated Convertrilo token balance.
